architectures.original_format_limits: Official config requests dynamic FP8 e4m3fn with 128x128 blocks (router gate/correction bias/head exclusions), despite nominal dtype BF16. Native CPU random BF16 fixture does not exercise FP8 loading, dequantization or kernels. Original capture requires already-downloaded licensed weights and a supported sufficiently provisioned FP8 runtime, normally CUDA; no production hardware fit or performance claim. Original config advertises use_mtp=true, three MTP modules/one transformer layer; the native M2 causal LM has no MTP implementation. Never add dummy MTP state. Unexpected source MTP tensors must remain a strict refusal unless an exact reviewed tensor-name inventory is independently pinned with QFS existing unexpected-tensor allowlist; no broad missing/mismatch flags are permitted.

No original-scale, MSA-kernel, video, left-padding equivalence or original-quality measurement is claimed.

Before claiming memory-bounded layer-outer support, measure actual K3 stream/window parity with attn_res_block_size enabled. Kimi layers return (prefix_sum, block_residual); both must survive proxies, and the original model must apply _apply_output_attn_res before final norm/head. Existing layer-outer proxies reportedly preserve entire outputs and the original outer loop; this authored workflow only measures window-outer until a separate parity report exists.
architectures.original_format_limits: Published source uses compressed-tensors mxfp4-pack-quantized weight format, floating4 group32 with uint8 scales; advertised serving includes MXFP8 activations. Original runtime needs a compressed-tensors version with MXFP4 pack support and matching supported accelerator kernels/serving engine; neither installed CPU Torch nor this BF16 reference fork implements packed MXFP4 or MXFP8. Fork preserves config/weight names for ordinary unquantized checkpoints only. Do not delete quantization metadata or reinterpret packed arrays as BF16; obtain an explicitly complete standard BF16/FP32 checkpoint for CPU capture.

runtime_correction.change: Per-instance RMSNorm replacement computes weighted normalization in FP32, then casts complete output to input activation dtype. Changes rounding boundary; not bit-identical native execution.
runtime_correction.dtype_boundary_audit: HyperConnection/HyperHead cast final outputs; sinks compute promoted score math then cast to values; compression bias promotes gate math then softmax casts to KV; correction bias only selects expert indices. Weighted RMSNorm alone lacks final cast.
runtime_correction.failure_observed_by_main: Native FP32-retained RMSNorm weight promotes BF16 activation output to FP32; next BF16Linear raises float != BFloat16.
runtime_correction.unchanged: All parameter names, values, dtype-retention policies and other native primitives. No global/library patch, autocast, guard disabling or output-correcting hooks.

original_format_limits.quantizer_plan_bug: hf_capture --drop-parallel-plan neutralizes unused single-process TP/EP plans to bypass the HF5.16.1 quantizer plan rewrite defect. This changes in-memory plans, not checkpoint quantization metadata/bytes, and is recorded by QFS.
